annotations.title: Upload media into your Soclo library

description: Upload media from a public https:// URL into Soclo so it can be used with soclo_post_publish. Pass a public https:// URL plus a filename and contentType (image/* or video/*); Soclo fetches it, stores it, adds it to your library and returns the owned assetId to use as a mediaId when publishing (soclo_library_search finds the same item). Safe to retry: pass a stable requestId and a repeated call returns the same asset instead of uploading a second copy; the same requestId with different content is refused, a failed attempt replays its own named error rather than re-running (use a NEW requestId to try again), and uploading the same source URL again reuses the copy you already own. Refuses: non-https URLs; hosts that are IP addresses, localhost, or on a private/internal network (including a redirect that leads to one); files over 50 MB; any contentType outside image/* or video/*; and bytes that are not actually the image or video file the contentType claims. Requires publish:post, the same permission as publishing itself, because uploaded media only exists to be posted.

contentType.description: Must be image/… or video/…, e.g. image/jpeg or video/mp4, and must match the file’s real bytes.

requestId.description: Stable id for this exact upload. REUSE it on a retry so the media is never uploaded twice. Omit to have Soclo derive one from the source.

url.description: A public https:// URL to the media file.
